references.text: God promises to bless Abraham, which is the foundation for the priestly blessing in Numbers
God promises to keep Jacob wherever he goes, reflecting 'bless and keep' in the Aaronic blessing
The psalmist asks that God would bless and make His face shine, a clear allusion to the Aaronic blessing
The Lord will keep you from all evil; He will keep your soul - reflects the keeping aspect of the blessing
The Lord has remembered us; He will bless - shows God's blessing upon His people
Promises of blessing for obedience to God, which expand on the content of the priestly blessing
Peter wishes grace and peace in ever-increasing measure, reflecting the Old Testament blessing formula
Jude's closing blessing that God may keep from falling connects to the keeping aspect of the Aaronic blessing
